note: The decompressed VBA dir stream supplies the record size field; the candidate sets a MODULE record size that leaves the parser at the end of data after the module name.
The input-controlled MODULE record size advances data_offset past the one byte module name to the end of the decompressed dir buffer.
The parser should require that at least two bytes remain for the next MODULENAMEUNICODE record id before dereferencing data at data_offset.
With data_offset at data_len, the uint16_t load reads past the end of the decompressed VBA dir buffer.
